exchange_rates.spread_note: Parallel premium over official = 8.52/6.3732 ≈ 33.7%. For COD revenue analysis, LYD collected in cash converts to USD at the PARALLEL rate (~8.5), not the official rate, unless the importer has CBL letter-of-credit access at the official rate.

shipping.battery_caveat: P06 (toothbrush) and P12 (shaver) contain lithium batteries; P03 likely does. Battery goods are restricted/ surcharged on air freight — sea or special battery-line air is typically required (estimate/reasoning, no single source; consistent with standard freight practice).

customs.structure: Libya abolished traditional customs duties on most goods in Aug 2005; imports instead pay a 4% Port Services Tax on CIF value, plus category-specific Production Tax (2%) and Consumption Tax (25% or 50%) on regulated products. No VAT.

import_tax_2026.context: New import tax law moved to implementation by CBL as the dollar passed 10 LYD (early 2026); Tripoli government contested it. Rates should be confirmed at HS-code level.

customs.compliance: Importers need a CBL Letter of Credit, Electronic Cargo Tracking Note (ECTN), Arabic labeling, pre-shipment Certificate of Inspection, and Ministry of Economy product registration. Source: https://carraglobe.com/importer-of-record-libya/ (via search snippet)

cod_return_rates.note: No Libya-specific COD return-rate figure verified yet; Shipeh site not yet checked. Regional MENA/North Africa proxies above. A Libya COD refusal rate of 25-40% is a reasonable ESTIMATE (reasoning: cash-only market, weak addressing, above-UAE logistics friction), not a sourced figure.

notes: All Libyan domains (cbl.gov.ly, libyaobserver.ly, libyaakhbar.com, ly.opensooq.com, ubuy.com.ly, meam.ly, dollar2day.com) returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch from this environment; every LYD figure therefore comes from WebSearch result snippets and is dated where the snippet allowed. Key takeaway: the official/parallel FX spread (~6.37 vs ~8.52, ~34%) is the single biggest margin variable for a COD importer. meam.ly is a confirmed live Libyan online store useful for retail price benchmarking (SHEIN-sourced goods: shapewear 51 LYD, gold-plated necklace set 21 LYD).
